deskyard status: show the desktop's name, state, image and screen

Usage: deskyard [-d NAME] status [--json]

Shows which desktop the command talks to and its state, image and screen size.

Options:
  --json               print JSON instead of text

Prints: "key: value" lines; with --json an object

Examples:
  deskyard -d alice status

Where: inside a desktop it acts locally; elsewhere on the chosen remote (-d NAME)
Exit codes: 0 ok, 1 error, 2 usage error
